title: HD Video Player All Format
summary: HD Video Player all formats with subtitle, 4K/HD, private folder, File manager
description:
HD Video Player All Format is an all-in-one Video Player supports All video formats, setting passwords to keep private videos safe, Full HD, 4K, Ultra HD video files, subtitle, network streams, media manager. It is one of the best easy-to-use video player to auto detect and manage, play all HD video and music files on Android devices, SD card, discs and network streaming protocols.

Video Player All Format supports hiding your personal videos or movies in the private folder safely. With HD Video Player, you can set a password to protect your private videos from being seen by other people.

HD Video Player All Formats for Android is a powerful video playback tool with advanced hardware acceleration and subtitle, music, multi playback option, pop-up window background play and cast videos. With HD Video Player, you can enjoy fast & stable 4K playback and video downloader, transfer, network shares, drives and DVD ISOs.

Download Video Player All Formats for android tablets and android phones now to play your favorite songs and videos!

💎 Top Features of HD Video Player 💎
● Support ALL video formats, including MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, RMVB, TS MPEG, MPG, RM, VOB, ASF, TP, M3U, m3u8, etc.
● Protects your private videos and music with password
● Supports 4K/ultra HD and all types of video
● Background playback, Pop-up window, Night mode, split screen
● All Subtitle formats and multiple subtitle downloader
● Pinch to zoom, screen lock, auto rotation, change aspect ratio
● Auto detect and manage local media files
● HQ music player, mp3 files, m4a files, all audio supported

🎬 HD Video Player All Formats Allow Multi-tasking
- Smart Floating Video Player: floating-play window can be moved and resized. Allow you to chat with other apps while watching videos.
- Background Video Player: play the video in the background like music playback. You can watch a video in the way of multi-tasking.
- Easy Gesture Control: Zoom and pan. adjust playback speed, brightness, volume and seeking. 
- Night Mode and Quick Mute: Night Mode to protect eyes from blue light, Quick Mute option in Player screen. 
- Screen lock and Kid lock: Prevent misuse when the video is playing and Immerse yourself in the video. 

🔥 HD Video Player with Subtitles, Private folder, Speed Control
- HD Video Player: full HD videos, 4k videos, 1080p videos, video player for all format
- Private folder: Hide your secret videos to your private folder and protect your privacy
- Subtitle Function: automatic synchronization. Search and free download online subtitle to watch movies with English/Hindi/Tamil subtitles etc.
- Subtitle gestures: Up and down to move text up and down. Change text size, background, shadow
- File Manager: Create and manage Video and Music Playlist. Manage Recently played videos and songs, resume plackback
- Control Speed: change media speed from 0.25 to 4.0 easily

🏆 Powerful Video Player & Music Player 
- Powerful Equalizer: Equalizer, Bass Boost, Virtualizer and Dual Audio in Video Player and Music Player. 
- Smooth music playback: widget for audio control, supports audio headsets control, cover art
- Video to audio converter: One click to convert videos to MP3 and other audios

🚀 Smart Gesture Control & Useful Functions
- Hardware acceleration, SW decoder and Video player with casting to TV
- Video playback continuous from the last position smartly
- Quick search, play and download online videos and music
- Set sleep timer for Video and Music player
- Fast file transfer, manage or share videos easily
- A-B Repeat & shuffle, order, loop mode
- Custom themes, Multi-track audio and subtitles

Simple and powerful Video Player All Format gives you the best experience for watching videos or listening to music! 🎦🎊
